parole.significato: dog days (period of time, in Finland traditionally July 23rd to August 23rd)
parole.testo: From mätä (“rot”) + kuu (“month”), a calque of Swedish rötmånad (“rot month”), from Danish, from Middle Low German rodendage (“dog days”), i.e. the days after the Heliacal rising of the Dog Star (Sirius), which was an important phenomenon in the astronomy of the olden times.
